description: Settings for work packages, material requirements and inspection appointments (Corevatis)

fields.description: When a sales order with a project is submitted: one task per remediation method with target hours from the BOMs.
fields.label: Create Work Packages on Submit

fields.description: Fitters working on a site at the same time. Duration of a work package = target hours / (team size)
fields.label: Team Size

fields.description: Working hours per day and fitter (Monday to Friday, holidays of the company's holiday list are skipped)
fields.label: Daily Working Hours

fields.description: When a sales order with a project is submitted: one draft material request with the aggregated BOM materials.
fields.label: Create Material Request on Submit

fields.description: Purchase: order into the main warehouse. Material Transfer: from the main warehouse to the vehicle.
fields.label: Material Request Type

fields.description: Added to every material quantity from the BOMs
fields.label: Waste Allowance (%)

fields.description: Request only the quantity not covered by the projected stock of the target warehouse
fields.label: Consider Current Stock

fields.description: Empty: default warehouse of the company (Hauptlager)
fields.label: Main Warehouse

fields.description: Target of a material transfer. Empty: warehouse “Fahrzeug” of the company
fields.label: Vehicle Warehouse

fields.description: Default time on site for an inspection; adjustable in the dialog “Schedule Appointment”
fields.label: Inspection Duration (Minutes)

fields.description: Kept free between the end of one appointment plus travel and the start of the next
fields.label: Buffer Between Appointments (Minutes)

fields.description: Used whenever an address has no coordinates (not found, no network, geocoding disabled); shown as “estimated”
fields.label: Travel Time Without Geocoding (Minutes)

fields.description: No requests to OpenStreetMap (Nominatim); all travel times use the default travel time
fields.label: Disable Geocoding

fields.description: Travel distance = straight-line distance × detour factor
fields.label: Detour Factor

fields.description: Travel time = travel distance ÷ average speed, rounded up to 5 minutes
fields.label: Average Speed (km/h)

fields.description: Travel time between two places is never shorter than this
fields.label: Minimum Travel Time (Minutes)

name: Corevatis Planung Einstellungen
